description: Optional configuration for an annotation-focus gather, which windows text around a mark. Distinct from the resource-focus options (depth / maxResources / includeContent / includeSummary), which traverse the resource graph.

includeSourceContext.description: Whether to include source context in the gathered result

includeTargetContext.description: Whether to include target context in the gathered result

contextWindow.description: How much of the text on each side of the annotation to include, counted in Unicode code points
